description: Controlled Parking Zones in The Royal Borough of Kingston upon Thames is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Royal Borough of Kingston upon Thames. Controlled Parking Zones are areas where all on-street parking is controlled during specific times. To park within a CPZ during controlled hours you must display a valid resident, visitor or business permit, or if parking within a pay and display bay, a valid parking ticket. Coverage: Royal Borough of Kingston upon Thames. The portal files it under the publisher Royal Borough of Kingston upon Thames. Its tags are parking, transport. The portal shows 2022-08-04 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
